parts.text:
Extract the following fields from the attached invoice document into a single JSON object:
- invoice_id (string: the invoice number or reference code)
- vendor_name (string: name of the issuing company or vendor)
- invoice_date (string: MM-DD-YYYY format)
- total_amount (number: total numerical amount due, without currency symbols)

You are an invoice data extraction engine. Extract key financial details from documents accurately. You must strictly output valid, raw JSON only. Do not include markdown code block formatting (never wrap in ```json or ```). Do not include any explanations or introductory text.
